  }

  export interface FlowContext<In, P, Out> {
    readonly input: In;
    readonly params: P;
    readonly out: Out;
    readonly unit: K.UnitView;
    readonly attempt: K.AttemptView;
  }
  export interface LoopRound<C> { readonly round: number; readonly carry: C | null }
  type Ctx<In, P, Out, X> = FlowContext<In, P, Out> & X;

  export interface Flow<In, P, Out, Sp, L extends string> extends K.Named {
    readonly entity: 'flow';
    readonly types?: { input: In; params: P; out: Out; spawns: Sp; labels: L };
  }

  export interface FlowDraft<In, P, Out, Sp, L extends string, X> extends K.Named {
    readonly entity: 'flow-draft';
    requires<S extends Shape>(shape: S): FlowDraft<Obj<S>, P, Out, Sp, L, X>;
    params<S extends Shape>(shape: S): FlowDraft<In, Obj<S>, Out, Sp, L, X>;
    step<Q extends string, I, O>(
      key: Q,
      executable: K.Executable<I, O>,
      input: (c: Ctx<In, P, Out, X>) => I,
      options?: StepOptions<I>,
    ): FlowDraft<In, P, Out & { [R in Q]: O }, Sp, L, X>;
    batch<Q extends string, I, O>(
      key: Q,
      agent: Agent<I, O>,
      items: (c: Ctx<In, P, Out, X>) => readonly I[],
      options?: StepOptions<I>,
    ): FlowDraft<In, P, Out & { [R in Q]: readonly O[] }, Sp, L, X>;
    halt<Q extends string, D extends Shape>(
      key: Q,
      spec: {
        ask: (c: Ctx<In, P, Out, X>) => string;
        decision: D;
        skip?: { when: K.GatePolicy; decision: Obj<D> };
      },
    ): FlowDraft<In, P, Out & { [R in Q]: Obj<D> }, Sp, L, X>;
    spawn<Q extends string, O extends string, S extends Shape>(
      key: Q,
      spec: { outlet: O; child: S; items: (c: Ctx<In, P, Out, X>) => readonly Obj<S>[] },
    ): FlowDraft<In, P, Out & { [R in Q]: readonly K.ChildView[] }, Sp & { [R in O]: Obj<S> }, L, X>;
    wait<Q extends string>(key: Q, delay: K.Delay): FlowDraft<In, P, Out & { [R in Q]: K.TimerPayload }, Sp, L, X>;
    loop<Q extends string, C extends Shape, B>(
      key: Q,
      spec: { carry: C; rounds: (c: Ctx<In, P, Out, X>) => number },
      body: (round: FlowDraft<In, P, Out, Sp, L, X & LoopRound<Obj<C>>>) => FlowDraft<In, P, B, Sp, L, X & LoopRound<Obj<C>>>,
      again: (last: B, c: Ctx<In, P, Out, X>) => Obj<C> | null,
    ): FlowDraft<In, P, Out & { [R in Q]: { rounds: number; last: B; exhausted: boolean } }, Sp, L, X>;
    sets<S extends ScalarShape>(shape: S, make: (c: Ctx<In, P, Out, X>) => Obj<S>): FlowDraft<In & Obj<S>, P, Out, Sp, L, X>;
    mark<M extends string>(label: M): FlowDraft<In, P, Out, Sp, L | M, X>;
    exit<E extends string>(label: E, when: (c: Ctx<In, P, Out, X>) => boolean): FlowDraft<In, P, Out, Sp, L | E, X>;
    ends<E extends string>(labels: readonly E[], pick: (c: Ctx<In, P, Out, X>) => NoInfer<E>): Flow<In, P, Out, Sp, L | E | 'failed'>;
  }

  export interface SpawnTarget<C> {
    readonly entity: 'spawn-target';
    readonly lane: K.Named;
    readonly types?: { child: (child: C) => void };
  }

  type HandlerConfig<U, In, St extends State, P, Sp, L extends string> =
    { states: { [Q in L]: St } } &
    ({} extends P ? { params?: P } : { params: P }) &
    ({} extends Sp ? { spawns?: {} } : { spawns: { [Q in keyof Sp]: SpawnTarget<Sp[Q]> } }) &
    ([U] extends [In] ? {} : { unitDoesNotSatisfyFlowInput: never });

  export interface ReactionSpec<A, St extends State, Pl> {
    readonly from?: readonly St[];
    readonly sets?: (payload: Pl, unit: K.UnitView<A>) => Partial<A>;
  }

  export interface Lane<A, F, St extends State, Ev, Tm extends string, Out> extends K.LaneLike<A> {
    readonly entity: 'lane';
    readonly types?: { attributes: A; fields: F; state: St; events: Ev; timers: Tm; out: Out };
    supply(suppliers: readonly K.Supplier<K.Supply<A, F, Ev>>[]): Lane<A, F, St, Ev, Tm, Out>;
    store(store: K.Store): Lane<A, F, St, Ev, Tm, Out>;
    handler<In, P, O, Sp, L extends string>(
      flow: Flow<In, P, O, Sp, L>,
      config: HandlerConfig<A & F, In, St, P, Sp, L>,
    ): Lane<A, F, St, Ev, Tm, O>;
    runner(runner: K.Runner): Lane<A, F, St, Ev, Tm, Out>;
    preflight(check: K.CommandSpec): Lane<A, F, St, Ev, Tm, Out>;
    wip(max: number): Lane<A, F, St, Ev, Tm, Out>;
    budget(budget: { maxUsdPerUnit: number; onExceed: 'halt' | 'fail' }): Lane<A, F, St, Ev, Tm, Out>;
    reaction<N extends (keyof Ev & string) | Tm>(
      event: N,
      to: St,
      spec?: ReactionSpec<A, St, PayloadOf<Ev, N>>,
    ): Lane<A, F, St, Ev, Tm, Out>;
  }

  export interface Source<E> {
    readonly entity: 'source';
    readonly types?: { event: E };
  }

  export interface Trigger<E> extends K.TriggerSpec {
    readonly entity: 'trigger';
    where(test: (event: E) => boolean): Trigger<E>;
    creates<A, F, St extends State, Ev, Tm extends string, O>(
      lane: Lane<A, F, St, Ev, Tm, O>,
      make: (event: E) => K.Create<A, F>,
    ): Trigger<E>;
    sends<A, F, St extends State, Ev, Tm extends string, O, N extends keyof Ev & string>(
      lane: Lane<A, F, St, Ev, Tm, O>,
      event: N,
      make: (event: E) => { key: string; payload: Ev[N] },
    ): Trigger<E>;
    records(journal: Journal, make: (event: E) => readonly K.MemoryDraft[]): Trigger<E>;
    invokes<I, O>(executable: K.Executable<I, O>, make: (event: E) => I): Trigger<E>;
    pauses(lane: K.LaneLike<unknown>): Trigger<E>;
    resumes(lane: K.LaneLike<unknown>): Trigger<E>;
  }

  export interface Metric extends K.MetricSpec { readonly entity: 'metric' }

  export interface Threshold<G> extends K.ThresholdSpec {
    readonly entity: 'threshold';
    readonly types?: { group: G };
  }

  export interface Operation extends K.OperationSpec { readonly entity: 'operation' }

  export interface OperationDraft<I> extends K.Named {
    input<S extends Shape>(shape: S): OperationDraft<Obj<S>>;
    invokes<EI, EO>(executable: K.Executable<EI, EO>, prepare: (input: I) => EI): Operation;
  }

  export interface Access extends K.AccessSpec {
    readonly entity: 'access';
    allows(operations: readonly Operation[]): Access;
  }

  export interface Harness extends K.Named {
    readonly entity: 'harness';
    ledger(ledger: K.Ledger): Harness;
    lanes(lanes: readonly K.LaneLike<unknown>[]): Harness;
    triggers(triggers: readonly K.TriggerSpec[]): Harness;
    schedule(policy: K.SchedulePolicy): Harness;
    clients(clients: readonly K.Client[]): Harness;
    projections(projections: readonly K.Projection[]): Harness;
    start(): Promise<K.Running>;
  }

  export const H: {
    env(name: string): K.EnvRef;
    slot: { port(index: number): K.PortRef };

    state<N extends string, P extends 'pending' | 'active' | 'waiting'>(name: N, position: P): State<N, P, null>;
    state<N extends string, V extends K.Verdict>(name: N, position: 'terminal', verdict: V): State<N, 'terminal', V>;
    work(name: string): WorkKind;
    role(name: string): Role;
    memory: { experience(name: string): MemoryKind; taste(name: string): MemoryKind };

    command(name: string, argv: readonly string[]): Command;
    agent<I, O>(name: string, role: Role<I, O>): Agent<I, O>;
    pool(name: string): Pool;
    journal(name: string, kind: MemoryKind): Journal;
    retry: {
      exponential(spec: { maxRetries: number; initialDelayMs: number; maxDelayMs?: number }): Retry;
      fixed(spec: { maxRetries: number; delayMs: number }): Retry;
    };

    time: {
      every(interval: K.Duration): K.Recurrence;
      daily(at: string, timeZone?: string): K.Recurrence;
      weekly(day: K.Weekday, at: string, timeZone?: string): K.Recurrence;
      monthly(dayOfMonth: number, at: string, timeZone?: string): K.Recurrence;
      after(delay: K.Duration): K.Delay;
    };

    flow(name: string): FlowDraft<{}, {}, {}, {}, never, {}>;
    lane<A, F, St extends State, Ev, Tm extends string>(name: string, kind: WorkKind<A, F, St, Ev, Tm>): Lane<A, F, St, Ev, Tm, {}>;
    child<A, F, St extends State, Ev, Tm extends string, O, C>(
      lane: Lane<A, F, St, Ev, Tm, O>,
      create: (child: C) => K.Create<A, F>,
    ): SpawnTarget<C>;

    supply: {
      operator(): K.Supplier<never>;
      schedule<A, F, St extends State, Ev, Tm extends string>(
        kind: WorkKind<A, F, St, Ev, Tm>,
        when: K.Recurrence,
        make: (c: K.ScheduleSupplyContext<A>) => readonly K.Supply<A, F, Ev>[],
      ): K.Supplier<K.Supply<A, F, Ev>>;
    };

    metric(name: string): {
      step<In, P, O, Sp, L extends string, Q extends keyof O & string>(
        flow: Flow<In, P, O, Sp, L>,
        key: Q,
      ): { hit(test: (output: O[Q], event: K.StepEvent<K.Attributes, O[Q]>) => boolean | null): Metric };
      transition<A, F, St extends State, Ev, Tm extends string, O>(
        lane: Lane<A, F, St, Ev, Tm, O>,
      ): { hit(test: (event: K.TransitionEvent<A, O>) => boolean | null): Metric };
      invocations(include?: (invocation: K.InvocationView) => boolean): {
        hit(test: (invocation: K.InvocationView) => boolean | null): Metric;
      };
    };

    threshold<A = {}, Q extends keyof A & string = never>(
      name: string,
      metric: Metric,
      spec: {
        lane?: K.LaneLike<A>;
        per?: Q;
        window: K.Duration;
        minN: number;
        breach: K.Band;
        recovery: K.Band;
      },
    ): Threshold<[Q] extends [never] ? null : A[Q]>;

    on: {
      transition<A, F, St extends State, Ev, Tm extends string, O>(
        lane: Lane<A, F, St, Ev, Tm, O>,
        filter?: { to?: readonly NoInfer<St>[]; verdict?: readonly K.Verdict[]; position?: readonly K.Position[] },
      ): Source<K.TransitionEvent<A, O>>;
      streak<A, F, St extends State, Ev, Tm extends string, O>(
        lane: Lane<A, F, St, Ev, Tm, O>,
        spec: { verdict: K.Verdict; count: number; per: keyof A & string },
      ): Source<K.StreakEvent<A>>;
      step<A, F, St extends State, Ev, Tm extends string, O, Q extends keyof O & string>(
        lane: Lane<A, F, St, Ev, Tm, O>,
        key: Q,
      ): Source<K.StepEvent<A, O[Q]>>;
      event<A, F, St extends State, Ev, Tm extends string, O, N extends (keyof Ev & string) | Tm>(
        lane: Lane<A, F, St, Ev, Tm, O>,
        name: N,
      ): Source<K.ReceivedEvent<A, PayloadOf<Ev, N>>>;
      crossing<G>(threshold: Threshold<G>, direction: K.Crossing): Source<K.CrossingEvent<G>>;
    };
    trigger<E>(name: string, source: Source<E>): Trigger<E>;

    policy: {
      schedule(name: string, decide: (c: K.ScheduleContext) => K.ScheduleDecision): K.SchedulePolicy;
      model<M extends K.Model>(name: string, options: readonly M[], decide: (c: K.PolicyContext, options: readonly M[]) => M): K.ChoicePolicy<K.Model>;
      account(name: string, decide: (c: K.AccountContext) => K.AccountView | null): K.AccountPolicy;
      gate(name: string, decide: (c: K.PolicyContext) => boolean): K.GatePolicy;
      recall(name: string, decide: (c: K.RecallContext) => readonly K.RecallCandidate[]): K.RecallPolicy;
    };

    ops: {
      readonly readWork: Operation;
      readonly createWork: Operation;
      readonly updateWork: Operation;
      readonly sendEvents: Operation;
      readonly resolveBlocks: Operation;
      readonly readMemory: Operation;
      readonly writeMemory: Operation;
      readonly curateMemory: Operation;
      readonly readTelemetry: Operation;
      readonly readAccounts: Operation;
      readonly setShares: Operation;
    };
    operation(name: string): OperationDraft<{}>;
    access(name: string): Access;

    harness(name: string): Harness;
  };
}

import { z } from 'zod';
import { H } from 'harness-dsl';
import * as sqlite from 'harness-dsl/sqlite';
import * as jsonl from 'harness-dsl/jsonl';
import * as claude from 'harness-dsl/claude-code';
import * as anthropic from 'harness-dsl/anthropic';
import * as linear from 'harness-dsl/linear';
import * as folder from 'harness-dsl/folder';
import * as markdown from 'harness-dsl/markdown';
import * as git from 'harness-dsl/git';
import * as local from 'harness-dsl/local';

const Queued = H.state('queued', 'pending');
const Building = H.state('building', 'active');
const NeedsOwner = H.state('needs-owner', 'waiting');
const Done = H.state('done', 'terminal', 'success');

const Proposed = H.state('proposed', 'pending');
const Planning = H.state('planning', 'active');
const Incomplete = H.state('incomplete', 'waiting');
const Complete = H.state('complete', 'terminal', 'success');

const HeartbeatDue = H.state('due', 'pending');
const Probing = H.state('probing', 'active');
const Healthy = H.state('healthy', 'terminal', 'success');
const Unhealthy = H.state('unhealthy', 'terminal', 'failure');

const ticketAttributes = { ref: z.string(), title: z.string(), priority: z.number(), source: z.string() };
const ticketFields = { description: z.string() };

const Bug = H.work('bug')
  .attributes(ticketAttributes)
  .fields(ticketFields)
  .states([Queued, Building, NeedsOwner, Done])
  .key((u) => u.attributes.ref);

const Feature = H.work('feature')
  .attributes(ticketAttributes)
  .fields(ticketFields)
  .states([Queued, Building, NeedsOwner, Done])
  .key((u) => u.attributes.ref);

const Epic = H.work('epic')
  .attributes(ticketAttributes)
  .fields(ticketFields)
  .states([Proposed, Planning, Incomplete, Complete])
  .key((u) => u.attributes.ref);

const Heartbeat = H.work('service-heartbeat')
  .attributes({ service: z.string(), tick: z.number() })
  .states([HeartbeatDue, Probing, Healthy, Unhealthy])
  .key((u) => `${u.attributes.service}@${u.attributes.tick}`);

const Experience = H.memory.experience('experience');
const Taste = H.memory.taste('taste');

const bySpecificity = H.policy.recall('specificity-then-track-record', (c) =>
  [...c.candidates]
    .sort((a, b) => b.specificity - a.specificity || b.track.succeeded - a.track.succeeded)
    .slice(0, c.limit),
);

const experienceJournal = H.journal('team-experience', Experience)
  .store(jsonl.memory('./memory/experience.jsonl'))
  .recall(bySpecificity);

const tasteJournal = H.journal('owner-taste', Taste)
  .store(jsonl.memory('./memory/taste.jsonl'))
  .recall(bySpecificity);

const accountQuota = sqlite.quota('./.harness/accounts.db');
const max1 = claude.subscription('max-1', { configDir: H.env('CLAUDE_CONFIG_MAX_1'), quota: accountQuota });
const max2 = claude.subscription('max-2', { configDir: H.env('CLAUDE_CONFIG_MAX_2'), quota: accountQuota });
const max3 = claude.subscription('max-3', { configDir: H.env('CLAUDE_CONFIG_MAX_3'), quota: accountQuota });
const apiAccount = anthropic.account('api-fallback', { apiKey: H.env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'), quota: accountQuota });

const soonestExpiring = H.policy.account('soonest-expiring-first', (c) =>
  [...c.eligible].sort((a, b) => a.windowEndsAt - b.windowEndsAt)[0] ?? null,
);

const claudePool = H.pool('claude-subscriptions')
  .accounts([
    { account: max1, share: 0.4 },
    { account: max2, share: 0.3 },
    { account: max3, share: 0.3 },
  ])
  .prefer(soonestExpiring)
  .fallback(apiAccount);

const sonnet = claude.model('claude-sonnet-4-5');
const opus = claude.model('claude-opus-4-1');

const builderModel = H.policy.model('builder-model', [sonnet, opus], (c) => {
  const cheaper = c.metrics.attempts({
    model: sonnet,
    kind: c.unit ? c.unit.kind : 'bug',
    window: { days: 14 },
  });
  return cheaper.n >= 20 && cheaper.rate !== null && cheaper.rate < 0.85 ? opus : sonnet;
});

const projectChecks = H.command('project-checks', ['npm', 'run', 'check']);

const builderRole = H.role('builder')
  .intents(['read', 'write', 'execute', 'search', 'ask'])
  .instructions('Implement the work item. Address every listed deficit. Ask the owner when a decision is theirs.')
  .input({ title: z.string(), description: z.string(), deficits: z.array(z.string()) })
  .output({ summary: z.string() });

const auditorRole = H.role('auditor')
  .intents(['read', 'execute', 'search', 'remember'])
  .instructions('Audit the change against the work item. List every deficit; list none if the work is complete.')
  .input({ title: z.string(), description: z.string(), changes: z.string() })
  .output({ deficits: z.array(z.string()) });

const plannerRole = H.role('planner')
  .intents(['read', 'search'])
  .instructions('Decompose the epic into independently shippable features.')
  .input({ title: z.string(), description: z.string() })
  .output({ features: z.array(z.object({ title: z.string(), description: z.string() })) });

const builder = H.agent('builder', builderRole)
  .model(builderModel)
  .pool(claudePool)
  .recalls([experienceJournal, tasteJournal])
  .leaseWrites()
  .mustPass(projectChecks);

const auditor = H.agent('auditor', auditorRole)
  .model(opus)
  .pool(claudePool)
  .recalls([experienceJournal])
  .records(experienceJournal);

const planner = H.agent('planner', plannerRole)
  .model(opus)
  .pool(claudePool)
  .recalls([tasteJournal]);

const ticketFlow = H.flow('ticket')
  .requires({ title: z.string(), description: z.string() })
  .params({ rounds: z.number() })
  .mark('building')
  .loop(
    'rounds',
    { carry: { deficits: z.array(z.string()) }, rounds: (c) => c.params.rounds },
    (round) =>
      round

  const rank = (x: (typeof c.candidates)[number]): number =>
    x.is(incidentLane) ? 0 : x.is(heartbeatLane) ? 1 : x.is(renewalLane) ? 2 : 3;

    preempt: incidentWaiting

  if (message.type === 'walkAway') return { key: message.negotiationId, event: 'vendorWalkedAway', payload: { reason: message.text } };

# harness-dsl, durable lens, generation 1 (surface cut)

A unit of work is a durable execution. Its identity outlives processes and attempts. The ledger is the event history the engine replays. This generation does two things:

- It cuts the parent's surface to what the battery calls.
- It repairs the lifecycle against the amended principle 12. The parent's sixth outcome `ended` is gone.

## Execution vocabulary (one definition each)

- **Unit**: one piece of work of one kind. It has a stable id and a `key` (from `Kind.key`). The key is used for signal routing and for create-deduplication. A unit is at one **position**: pending, active, waiting or terminal.
- **Attempt**: one execution of a unit's flow, from a start step to an end.
  - **Open statuses:**
    - `running` holds capacity.
    - `blocked` is halted on a human decision. It holds nothing.
    - `parked` is in a `wait`, a `spawn`, a crash recovery or a ceiling stop. It holds nothing.
  - **Outcomes:** exactly `succeeded`, `failed` or `cancelled`.
    - An exit into a state whose verdict is `failure` ends the attempt `failed`.
    - Any other exit ends it `succeeded`.
    - A step failing after its retries ends it `failed`.
    - `H.cancel` and `restart` end it `cancelled`.
  - **Track record:** metrics on models, agents, runners and accounts are computed from these outcomes.
- **Step**: a named node of a flow: `step`, `halt`, `wait`, `spawn`, `loop` or `exit`.
  - Step outputs are recorded and form the replay state.
  - A command that exits non-zero fails its step. When a step needs a report rather than a failure, the command exits zero and declares an `output` schema.
- **Invocation**: one call of an executable inside a step. A retry is a new invocation. Cost, tokens, model, account and runner are recorded per invocation.

"Run" is not a word in this design.

## Entities

**Kinds** (vocabulary only):

- Work kind: `H.kind().attributes().states().key()`
- State: `H.state(name, position)`, or `H.state(name, 'terminal', verdict)`
- Signal: `H.signal().payload()`
- Role: `H.role().intents().instructions()`
- Memory kind: `H.memory(name, 'experience' | 'taste')`
- Command
- Flow
- Operation

**Instances** (each carries a backend, built in a subpath):

- Account
- Model
- Runner
- Workspace
- Supplier
- Store
- MemoryStore
- Ledger
- Client
- Observer

`H.clock` and `H.operator` are kernel suppliers.

**Pivots** (each names what it produces):

| Pivot | Combines | Produces |
|---|---|---|
| Lane | kind × suppliers × store × flow, plus the exit/during/failure/cancelled → state map | managed units |
| Agent | role × model or model policy | a model-call executable |
| Pool | accounts × shares × drain policy × fallback | quota-eligible access |
| Journal | memory kind × memory store × recall × reader roles | recalled memory |
| Trigger | source → consequences | recorded firings |
| Metric | source → samples | a rate with sample counts |
| Scheduler | priority, WIP, aging, rank, admission | start decisions |
| Harness | lanes, pools, journals, triggers, metrics, scheduler, ledger, clients, observers | a running harness |

## Rules

### Lifecycle (principle 12)

1. **Positions and verdicts.** Every state declares its position. Every terminal state declares its verdict (`success`, `failure` or `neutral`), and there is no default.
   - The kind's first state is its initial state.
   - A unit whose initial state is `waiting` is not scheduled until a signal restarts it.
2. **Flows know no states.** A flow ends at named exits. The lane maps:
   - `exits` to any state. This map is total, so a missing exit is a compile error.
   - `during` (step names) to non-terminal states.
   - `failure`: where a failed attempt moves the unit. If omitted, the unit stays where it is, while the failed attempt is still recorded and counted.
   - `cancelled`: where `H.cancel` moves it.

   Startup checks positions against step type:
   - a `during` state on a running step must be `active`;
   - a `during` state on a `halt`, `wait` or `spawn` step must be `waiting`.
3. **Capacity follows attempt status, not names.** Only `running` attempts hold runner slots, lane WIP and account reservations.

### Signals, timers, triggers

4. **Signals.** A supplier route can `create` a unit, `signal` one by key or by typed predicate, or `skip`.
   - **Create-deduplication.** A `create` whose key matches a non-terminal unit of the lane is a recorded no-op (`unitDeduplicated`).
   - **Reactions** declared with `Lane.on(signal, …)`:
     - `update` merges the payload into the unit's attributes.
     - `restart` cancels the open attempt and starts a new one at a typed step name.
     - `enter` transitions the unit, possibly reopening it.

   `H.cancel` is the one built-in signal.
5. **Timers.** `H.when.timer(lane, { at, if })` arms one timer per unit as a ledger `timerSet`.
   - `at` is re-evaluated on every `attributesUpdated`. If the date changed, a new `timerSet` supersedes the old one, and a superseded timer never fires.
   - `if` is evaluated at fire time.
   - `wait({ ms })` parks the attempt.
6. **Trigger sources.** `transition`, `pattern` (N consecutive per group), `timer`, `step`, `invocation`, and `threshold`.
   - **`invocation`** takes one lane, which gives typed unit attributes, or several lanes, which gives a source over all of them.
   - **`step`** events carry:
     - the step's typed `output`;
     - `steps`, the typed outputs recorded so far in the attempt, keyed by the lane's step names;
     - `models`, the model used per step.
   - **`threshold(metric, { trip, reset, minSamples, window, edge })`** is evaluated per group after each ledger append that adds samples. Its state machine is armed → tripped → armed.
     - It emits `thresholdCrossed` once per edge, and only with at least `minSamples` samples.
     - `trip` and `reset` are separate bounds, which gives hysteresis.
     - Two sources over the same metric and bounds share one state machine. Filtering them by `edge` lets one trigger act on the trip and another on the reset.
7. **Trigger consequences.**
   - `create(lane, attrs)`
   - `signal(lane, signal, e => { key, payload })`
   - `record(journal, draft)`, as candidate or active
   - `pause(lane)` and `resume(lane)`

   Every firing is recorded as `triggerFired`. Pause and resume are additionally recorded as `lanePaused` and `laneResumed`, which reference the threshold event that carries the rate.

### Metrics (principle 18)

8. **Definitions.**
   - `outcomes({ of, model?, window })` counts units entering terminal states, by verdict:
     - `successRate = success / (success + failure)`;
     - `samples = success + failure`, always reported beside the rate;
     - `neutral` is reported separately;
     - `byState` is keyed by the lane's typed state names.
   - Owner metrics are `H.metric().from(source).samples(e => [{ group, hit }])`, read with `rate(metric, { group, window })` as `{ rate, hits, samples }`.
   - `meanCostUsd` is the mean cost of succeeded attempts.
   - `pausedMs` is the total paused time of a lane.
   - Windows are rolling and may be fractional. "This month" is `windowDays` equal to the days elapsed since the first of the month.
9. **Negative human verdicts count.** A state such as Rejected is the owner's call. Its verdict is mandatory.

### Cost and scheduling

10. **Cost.**
    - `Lane.ceiling({ maxUsd, onExceed })` checks projected cost before each invocation.
    - The scheduler's `admit` reads `spentUsd(lanes, since)` from the ledger.
    - Batch invocations are priced by the driver at the batch rate.
11. **Scheduler.**
    - `priority` orders lanes.
    - `wip` caps running attempts.
    - `boost` ages a starved lane.
    - `rank` orders units within a lane (lower first).
    - `admit` gates a start, using two counts:
      - `AdmitCtx.active(lane)` counts running attempts;
      - `AdmitCtx.open(lane)` counts non-terminal units, including those blocked at a halt.

    Preemption is priority plus admission. Running attempts are never interrupted.

### Accounts and memory

12. **Accounts.** Accounts and models carry no relationships.
    - Each model is served by the one harness pool that has an account accepting it.
    - Share caps live on the pool.
    - Quota state is a facet of the ledger. `sqlite.ledger({ path, quotaPath })` lets several harnesses share the quota tables.
13. **Memory.** An item's body is forward-phrased `text` inside the kernel envelope.
    - Recall is deterministic: filter by scope, rank by specificity or by the store's similarity score, break ties by track record.
    - Reads take the union of all journals visible to the role.
    - Writes come from three places, each naming one journal: agents whose role is in `writtenBy`, triggers, and the control API (`memoryWrite`, `memoryCurate`).

### Restart and durability (scenario 10)

14. **Recovery.** The author writes nothing except `onCrash` on effectful steps, and `.check` on a command whose completion can be observed.
    - **Single writer.** The ledger holds a writer claim. A second process refuses to start while the first is alive, and takes over from a dead one.
    - **Completed steps** are replayed from their recorded outputs.
    - **The step that was running** is handled by its `onCrash` setting:
      - `rerun`: run it again.
      - `park`: park the attempt with `unsafeRerun`. This is the default for commands.
      - `ask`: ask the executable whether it finished. This is the default for agents and batches.
    - **`ask` by executable type:**
      - **Agents:** the driver resumes the session. Driver states map as follows:
        - a completed session is `confirmedDone`;
        - a still-running session is awaited;
        - an unknown session is parked with `driverUnknown`.
      - **Batches:** the batch is collected (`collected`) and never resubmitted.
      - **Commands:** the `.check` executable is run.
        - `true` gives `confirmedDone`, and the flow continues.
        - `false`, or a failing check, parks the attempt with `unsafeRerun`.
        - A command with `ask` is therefore never rerun.
    - **Halts, children and decisions.** Halts resolved while down are found in the inbox. Children are units, so their outcomes are already in the ledger.
    - **Identity of the attempt.** A recovered attempt keeps its id. Interruption is never an outcome.
    - **Changed definitions.** A changed flow fingerprint parks the attempt with `definitionChanged`.

### Control API and startup

15. **Control API.**
    - **Grants.** Clients are granted operations (`H.ops.*` and `H.operation(name).run(exec)`).
    - **Transports.** The supervisor and plain HTTP are two backends of one `ControlApi`.
    - **Shared clients.** One client descriptor may be registered in several harnesses. `Client.serve` is then called once per harness's `ControlApi`, which is how one supervisor session reaches two harnesses.
16. **Startup validation.** `start()` fails on any of these:
    - duplicate descriptor names;
    - a flow that can fall off its end;
    - an unregistered lane, journal, metric or pool;
    - a `during` position mismatch;
    - a terminal state without a verdict;
    - `H.cancel` received by a lane with no `cancelled` mapping;
    - `onCrash: 'ask'` on a command without `.check`;
    - a batch on a driver without `submitBatch`;
    - a model served by zero pools or by two.

## What changed and why

Versus g00-durable-0:

- **Lifecycle repaired to amended principle 12.**
  - `ended` is removed.
  - States declare a position, and terminal states declare a verdict.
  - Attempts have three outcomes.
  - `waiting` is a real position.
  - `failure` is optional.
- **Typed step and state names everywhere.**
  - `StepEvent.models` is keyed by step names.
  - `UnitView.state` and `byState` are typed.
  - `PolicyCtx.lane` is available.
  - Lanes and metrics are branded.
- **Relationships off instances.**
  - Pools are declared on the harness.
  - Shared quota is a ledger backend option.
- **Scenario 9 coverage.**
  - Threshold with hysteresis.
  - Invocation source.
  - Pause and resume.
  - Signal by key.
  - Create-deduplication.
  - Timer re-arm.
  - `pausedMs`.
- **Scenario 10 coverage.**
  - `onCrash` and `Command.check`.
  - Writer claim, inbox, and fingerprint.
  - `attemptsRecover`.
- **Surface cuts.** Removed or tightened:
  - `Budget` and `H.budget`;
  - the `await` step and buffered signals;
  - `wait.until`;
  - `transition.from`;
  - `AdmitCtx.pending`;
  - `H.retry`;
  - `MemoryKind.body` and `.trust()`;
  - `recall.minScore`;
  - `meanCostUsd.outcome`;
  - `Operation.input`;
  - `supervisor.endpoint`;
  - `worktree.base`;
  - `writtenBy` now accepts agent roles only;
  - `loop.max` is now required;
  - adapter options that every caller passes are now required.

Scenario pass 01–05:

- **`StepEvent.steps`** carries the typed outputs recorded so far in the attempt.
  - Scenario 2's approval-rate metric groups by the classifier's category, which is a step output, not an attribute.
  - Scenario 3 records prior findings from the synthesis output when the citation check passes.
  - Without this, both had to smuggle step data into human decisions or attributes.
- **`AdmitCtx.open(lane)`** counts non-terminal units.
  - In scenario 4, "no new Backup while an Incident is active" must see Incidents that are blocked at an acknowledgement halt.
  - Those Incidents hold no capacity, so `active` (running attempts) reports zero for them.
- **`ZendeskEvent.status`.** The helpdesk adapter now reports the ticket status. Scenario 2 can then route "closed by customer" as a signal instead of guessing it from the event type.
- **Command failure is now stated.** A command exiting non-zero fails its step. Scenarios 3 and 4 rely on this; scenario 5's validation exits zero with a report so that it can halt instead of failing.

Scenario pass 06–10 (this revision):

- **`H.when.invocation(...lanes)`.** A second overload takes any number of lanes and yields untyped unit attributes.
  - **The problem.** Scenario 9 pauses `conversations` on the model error rate and resumes it when the rate recovers. If `conversations` is the only lane that produces invocation samples, pausing it stops the samples.
  - **Why the old form failed.** The reset edge needs `minSamples`, so it could never fire: a deadlock that the single-lane source could not avoid.
  - **The fix.** The harness-wide error metric now reads `conversations` plus a cheap canary lane that keeps running while `conversations` is paused.
  - The single-lane overload is unchanged.
- **`onCrash: 'ask'` on commands is now stated** (rule 14).
  - A check that answers no parks the attempt; it never reruns the command.
  - Scenario 10's `announce` relies on this: "never rerun, unless we can tell the post happened".
- **Shared client descriptors are now stated** (rule 15). Scenario 7 registers one supervisor descriptor in two harnesses: one session, two control endpoints.
- **Month-to-date windows are stated** (rule 8). A fractional rolling `windowDays` expresses them, so no new window type is needed. Scenario 9 uses this.
- **Threshold sources filtered by `edge` share one state machine** (rule 6). Scenario 9 uses this to split trip and reset into separate triggers.

## Principles broken

none

- 12 is repaired: there is no added outcome.
- 15 is satisfied: quota is ledger state, and sharing it is a ledger-backend option, not a second store.

  export interface Route { readonly route: 'create' | 'signal' | 'skip' }

  export interface Router<A, SN extends string> {
    create(attrs: A): Route;
    signal<P>(
      signal: Signal<string, P>,
      target: string | ((unit: UnitView<A, SN>) => boolean),
      payload: NoInfer<P>,
    ): Route;
    skip(): Route;
  }

  export interface OperatorSupplier extends Named { readonly operator: true }

  export interface Lane<A, S extends State, St, N extends string> extends LaneShape<A, S, St> {
    readonly _types?: { readonly attrs: A; readonly states: S; readonly steps: St; readonly stepNames: N };
    supply(supplier: OperatorSupplier): Lane<A, S, St, N>;
    supply<E>(
      supplier: Supplier<E>,
      route: (event: E, to: Router<A, S['name']>) => Route | readonly Route[],
    ): Lane<A, S, St, N>;
    store(store: Store): Lane<A, S, St, N>;
    handler<St2, X extends string, N2 extends string>(
      flow: Flow<A, void, St2, X, N2>,
      map: HandlerMap<S, X, N2>,
    ): Lane<A, S, St2, N2>;
    handler<P, St2, X extends string, N2 extends string>(
      flow: Flow<A, P, St2, X, N2>,
      map: HandlerMap<S, X, N2> & { readonly params: P },
    ): Lane<A, S, St2, N2>;
    on<P>(signal: Signal<string, P>, reaction: Reaction<A, S, N, P>): Lane<A, S, St, N>;
    ceiling(ceiling: { readonly maxUsd: number; readonly onExceed: 'halt' | 'fail' }): Lane<A, S, St, N>;
  }

  export interface Tick { readonly at: Date }
  export type Weekday = 'mon' | 'tue' | 'wed' | 'thu' | 'fri' | 'sat' | 'sun';

  export interface Clock extends Supplier<Tick> {
    every(interval: { readonly minutes?: number; readonly hours?: number }): Clock;
    daily(at: string, options?: { readonly tz?: string }): Clock;
    weekly(day: Weekday, at: string, options?: { readonly tz?: string }): Clock;
    monthly(dayOfMonth: number, at: string, options?: { readonly tz?: string }): Clock;
  }

  export interface AttemptSummary {
    readonly number: number;
    readonly outcome: 'succeeded' | 'failed' | 'cancelled';
    readonly durationMs: number;
    readonly costUsd: number;
  }

  export interface TransitionEvent<A, SN extends string> {
    readonly unit: UnitView<A, SN>;
    readonly from: SN | undefined;
    readonly to: SN;
    readonly attempt?: AttemptSummary;
    readonly at: Date;
  }

  export interface PatternEvent<A, SN extends string> extends TransitionEvent<A, SN> {
    readonly group: string;
    readonly streak: number;
  }

  export interface TimerEvent<A, SN extends string> {
    readonly unit: UnitView<A, SN>;
    readonly at: Date;
  }

  export interface StepEvent<A, SN extends string, St, M extends keyof St> {
    readonly unit: UnitView<A, SN>;
    readonly step: M;
    readonly ok: boolean;
    readonly output?: St[M];
    readonly steps: { readonly [K in keyof St]?: St[K] };
    readonly models: { readonly [K in keyof St]?: string };
    readonly costUsd: number;
    readonly durationMs: number;
    readonly at: Date;
  }

  export interface InvocationEvent<A, SN extends string> {
    readonly unit: UnitView<A, SN>;
    readonly step: string;
    readonly model?: string;
    readonly ok: boolean;
    readonly costUsd: number;
    readonly at: Date;
  }

  export interface ThresholdEvent {
    readonly metric: string;
    readonly group: string;
    readonly edge: 'tripped' | 'reset';
    readonly rate: number;
    readonly samples: number;
    readonly at: Date;
  }

  export interface Source<E> extends Named { readonly _event?: E }

  export type StateMatch<S extends State> = S | Verdict | readonly S[];
  export type Bound = { readonly below: number } | { readonly above: number };

  export interface TriggerRef extends Named { readonly trigger: true }

  export interface Trigger<E> extends TriggerRef {
    on<E2>(source: Source<E2>): Trigger<E2>;
    create<A>(lane: LaneShape<A, State, unknown>, attrs: (event: E) => NoInfer<A> | undefined): Trigger<E>;
    signal<A, P>(
      lane: LaneShape<A, State, unknown>,
      signal: Signal<string, P>,
      target: (event: E) => { readonly key: string; readonly payload: NoInfer<P> } | undefined,
    ): Trigger<E>;
    record(journal: Journal, item: (event: E) => MemoryDraft | undefined): Trigger<E>;
    pause(lane: AnyLane): Trigger<E>;
    resume(lane: AnyLane): Trigger<E>;
  }

  export interface Sample { readonly group: string; readonly hit: boolean }

  export interface Metric<E> extends MetricRef {
    from<E2>(source: Source<E2>): Metric<E2>;
    samples(extract: (event: E) => readonly Sample[]): Metric<E>;
  }

  export interface AdmitCtx<A, SN extends string> {
    readonly unit: UnitView<A, SN>;
    readonly active: (lane: AnyLane) => number;
    readonly open: (lane: AnyLane) => number;
    readonly spentUsd: (lanes: readonly AnyLane[], since: Date) => number;
    readonly metrics: Metrics;
    readonly now: Date;
  }

  export interface Scheduler extends Named {
    priority(...lanes: AnyLane[]): Scheduler;
    wip(lane: AnyLane, maxActive: number): Scheduler;
    boost(lane: AnyLane, aging: { readonly afterMinutes: number }): Scheduler;
    rank<A, S extends State>(lane: LaneShape<A, S, unknown>, key: (unit: UnitView<A, S['name']>) => number): Scheduler;
    admit<A, S extends State>(lane: LaneShape<A, S, unknown>, gate: (ctx: AdmitCtx<A, S['name']>) => boolean): Scheduler;
  }

  export interface Grant extends Named { readonly grant: true }

  export interface Operation extends Grant {
    run(exec: Executable<void, unknown>): Operation;
  }

  export interface RunningHarness {
    readonly name: string;
    stop(): Promise<void>;
  }

  export interface Harness extends Named {
    ledger(ledger: Ledger): Harness;
    pools(...pools: Pool[]): Harness;
    lanes(...lanes: AnyLane[]): Harness;
    journals(...journals: Journal[]): Harness;
    triggers(...triggers: TriggerRef[]): Harness;
    metrics(...metrics: MetricRef[]): Harness;
    scheduler(scheduler: Scheduler): Harness;
    clients(...clients: Client[]): Harness;
    observers(...observers: Observer[]): Harness;
    start(): Promise<RunningHarness>;
  }

  export const H: {
    env(name: string): EnvRef;
    readonly slot: { port(slot: number): PortRef };
    nextTime(at: string, options: { readonly after: Date; readonly tz?: string }): Date;

    kind<N extends string>(name: N): Kind<N, Empty, never>;
    state<N extends string>(name: N, position: 'pending' | 'active' | 'waiting'): State<N>;
    state<N extends string>(name: N, position: 'terminal', verdict: Verdict): State<N>;
    signal<N extends string>(name: N): Signal<N, Empty>;
    readonly cancel: Signal<'cancel', { readonly reason?: string }>;
    role(name: string): Role;
    memory<N extends string>(name: N, trust: 'experience' | 'taste'): MemoryKind<N>;

    command(name: string): Command<void, CommandResult>;
    agent(name: string): Agent<string>;
    pool(name: string): Pool;
    readonly guard: {
      lease(): Guard;
      beforeStop(check: Executable<void, unknown>): Guard;
    };
    readonly policy: {
      model(name: string, candidates: readonly Model[], choose: (ctx: PolicyCtx) => Model): ModelPolicy;
      account(name: string, choose: (ctx: AccountPolicyCtx) => AccountState | undefined): AccountPolicy;
    };
    recall(name: string, options: { readonly by: 'specificity' | 'similarity'; readonly limit: number }): Recall;

    flow(name: string): Flow<unknown, void, Empty, never, never>;
    lane<A, S extends State>(name: string, kind: KindShape<A, S>): Lane<A, S, Empty, never>;
    journal(name: string, of: MemoryKind): Journal;
    clock(name: string): Clock;
    readonly operator: OperatorSupplier;

    trigger(name: string): Trigger<never>;
    readonly when: {
      transition<A, S extends State, St>(
        lane: LaneShape<A, S, St>,
        filter?: {
          readonly to?: StateMatch<NoInfer<S>>;
          readonly if?: (event: TransitionEvent<A, S['name']>) => boolean;
        },
      ): Source<TransitionEvent<A, S['name']>>;
      pattern<A, S extends State, St>(
        lane: LaneShape<A, S, St>,
        pattern: {
          readonly to: StateMatch<NoInfer<S>>;
          readonly consecutive: number;
          readonly per: (unit: UnitView<A, S['name']>) => string;
        },
      ): Source<PatternEvent<A, S['name']>>;
      timer<A, S extends State, St>(
        lane: LaneShape<A, S, St>,
        timer: {
          readonly at: (unit: UnitView<A, S['name']>) => Date;
          readonly if?: (unit: UnitView<A, S['name']>) => boolean;
        },
      ): Source<TimerEvent<A, S['name']>>;
      step<A, S extends State, St, M extends keyof St & string>(
        lane: LaneShape<A, S, St>,
        step: M,
        filter?: { readonly if?: (event: StepEvent<A, S['name'], St, M>) => boolean },
      ): Source<StepEvent<A, S['name'], St, M>>;
      invocation<A, S extends State, St>(lane: LaneShape<A, S, St>): Source<InvocationEvent<A, S['name']>>;
      invocation(...lanes: AnyLane[]): Source<InvocationEvent<unknown, string>>;
      threshold(
        metric: MetricRef,
        threshold: MetricWindow & {
          readonly trip: Bound;
          readonly reset: Bound;
          readonly minSamples: number;
          readonly edge?: 'tripped' | 'reset';
        },
      ): Source<ThresholdEvent>;
    };
    metric(name: string): Metric<never>;
    scheduler(name: string): Scheduler;

    operation(name: string): Operation;
    readonly ops: {
      readonly workRead: Grant;
      readonly workCreate: Grant;
      readonly workUpdate: Grant;
      readonly workCancel: Grant;
      readonly workSignal: Grant;
      readonly blockersResolve: Grant;
      readonly attemptsRecover: Grant;
      readonly memoryRead: Grant;
      readonly memoryWrite: Grant;
      readonly memoryCurate: Grant;
      readonly telemetryRead: Grant;
      readonly accountsRead: Grant;
      readonly accountsShare: Grant;
    };
    harness(name: string): Harness;
  };
}

import { z } from 'zod';
import { H } from 'harness-dsl';
import { sqlite } from 'harness-dsl/sqlite';
import { jsonl } from 'harness-dsl/jsonl';
import { claudeCode } from 'harness-dsl/claude-code';
import { anthropic } from 'harness-dsl/anthropic';
import { linear } from 'harness-dsl/linear';
import { folder, type FolderFile } from 'harness-dsl/folder';
import { git } from 'harness-dsl/git';
import { local } from 'harness-dsl/local';
import { markdown } from 'harness-dsl/markdown';

const ticket = z.object({ ref: z.string(), title: z.string(), description: z.string() });
const heartbeatAttributes = z.object({ service: z.string(), tickAt: z.string() });

const triage = H.state('Triage', 'pending');
const inProgress = H.state('InProgress', 'active');
const inReview = H.state('InReview', 'active');
const planning = H.state('Planning', 'active');
const awaitingFeatures = H.state('AwaitingFeatures', 'waiting');
const done = H.state('Done', 'terminal', 'success');
const unresolved = H.state('Unresolved', 'terminal', 'failure');
const cancelled = H.state('Cancelled', 'terminal', 'neutral');
const heartbeatDue = H.state('HeartbeatDue', 'pending');
const probing = H.state('Probing', 'active');
const healthy = H.state('Healthy', 'terminal', 'success');
const unhealthy = H.state('Unhealthy', 'terminal', 'failure');

const Bug = H.kind('Bug')
  .attributes(ticket)
  .states(triage, inProgress, inReview, done, unresolved, cancelled)
  .key(attrs => attrs.ref);
const Feature = H.kind('Feature')
  .attributes(ticket)
  .states(triage, inProgress, inReview, done, unresolved, cancelled)
  .key(attrs => attrs.ref);
const Epic = H.kind('Epic')
  .attributes(ticket)
  .states(triage, planning, awaitingFeatures, done, unresolved, cancelled)
  .key(attrs => attrs.ref);
const ServiceHeartbeat = H.kind('ServiceHeartbeat')
  .attributes(heartbeatAttributes)
  .states(heartbeatDue, probing, healthy, unhealthy)
  .key(attrs => `${attrs.service}@${attrs.tickAt}`);

const workstation = local.runner('workstation');

const projectChecks = H.command('project-checks')
  .argv(['npm', 'run', 'check'])
  .runner(workstation);

const serviceProbe = H.command('service-probe')
  .input(z.object({ service: z.string() }))
  .argv(input => ['curl', '-fsS', '--max-time', '10', `https://${input.service}.internal/health`])
  .runner(workstation);

const productionProbe = H.command('production-health-probe')
  .argv(['curl', '-fsS', '--max-time', '10', 'https://app.example.com/health'])
  .runner(workstation);

const claudeMaxA = claudeCode.subscription('claude-max-a', { token: H.env('CLAUDE_MAX_A_TOKEN') });
const claudeMaxB = claudeCode.subscription('claude-max-b', { token: H.env('CLAUDE_MAX_B_TOKEN') });
const claudeMaxC = claudeCode.subscription('claude-max-c', { token: H.env('CLAUDE_MAX_C_TOKEN') });
const apiAccount = anthropic.account('anthropic-api', { apiKey: H.env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY') });

const sonnet = claudeCode.model('sonnet', { id: 'claude-sonnet-4-5' });
const opus = claudeCode.model('opus', { id: 'claude-opus-4-1' });

const soonestExpiringFirst = H.policy.account('soonest-expiring-first', ctx =>
  ctx.candidates
    .filter(candidate => candidate.shareUsed < candidate.shareCap)
    .filter(candidate => !candidate.cooldownUntil || candidate.cooldownUntil <= ctx.now)
    .sort((left, right) => left.windowResetsAt.getTime() - right.windowResetsAt.getTime())[0],
);

const claudePool = H.pool('claude-subscriptions')
  .accounts(claudeMaxA, claudeMaxB, claudeMaxC)
  .share(claudeMaxA, 0.8)
  .share(claudeMaxB, 0.8)
  .share(claudeMaxC, 0.6)
  .drain(soonestExpiringFirst)
  .fallback(apiAccount);

const builderModel = H.policy.model('builder-model-by-track-record', [sonnet, opus], ctx => {
  const cheaper = ctx.metrics.outcomes({ of: ctx.lane, model: sonnet, windowDays: 14 });
  return cheaper.samples >= 20 && cheaper.successRate < 0.85 ? opus : sonnet;
});

const builderRole = H.role('builder')
  .intents('read', 'edit', 'run', 'search', 'halt')
  .instructions('Implement the unit of work in the worktree. Halt for the owner when a product decision is needed.');
const auditorRole = H.role('auditor')
  .intents('read', 'run', 'search', 'record')
  .instructions('Find deficits in the change. Record forward-phrased lessons that would have prevented them.');
const plannerRole = H.role('planner')
  .intents('read', 'search')
  .instructions('Decompose the epic into independently shippable features.');

const worktree = git.worktree({ repo: '.' });

const builder = H.agent('builder-agent')
  .role(builderRole)
  .model(builderModel)
  .workspace(worktree)
  .guards(H.guard.lease(), H.guard.beforeStop(projectChecks))
  .budgetTokens(400000);

const auditor = H.agent('auditor-agent')
  .role(auditorRole)
  .model(opus)
  .workspace(worktree)
  .output(z.object({ deficits: z.array(z.string()) }));

const planner = H.agent('planner-agent')
  .role(plannerRole)
  .model(opus)
  .output(z.object({ features: z.array(z.object({ title: z.string(), description: z.string() })) }));

const engineeringExperience = H.memory('engineering-experience', 'experience');
const ownerTaste = H.memory('owner-taste', 'taste');
const byScope = H.recall('by-scope', { by: 'specificity', limit: 12 });

const experienceJournal = H.journal('experience-journal', engineeringExperience)
  .store(jsonl.memoryStore({ path: '.harness/memory/experience.jsonl' }))
  .recall(byScope)
  .readBy(builderRole, auditorRole)
  .writtenBy(auditorRole);

const tasteJournal = H.journal('taste-journal', ownerTaste)
  .store(jsonl.memoryStore({ path: '.harness/memory/taste.jsonl' }))
  .recall(byScope)
  .readBy(builderRole, plannerRole);

const buildAndAudit = H.flow('build-and-audit')
  .input(ticket)
  .params(z.object({ rounds: z.number().int().positive() }))
  .loop(
    'rounds',
    round =>
      round
        .step('build', builder, ctx => ({
          task: `Implement ${ctx.unit.attributes.ref}: ${ctx.unit.attributes.title}\n\n${ctx.unit.attributes.description}`,
          skills: ['implementation'],
        }))
        .step('audit', auditor, ctx => ({
          task: `Audit the change for ${ctx.unit.attributes.ref} against its description and list every remaining deficit.`,
          skills: ['review'],
        })),
    {
      max: ctx => ctx.params.rounds,
      until: ctx => ctx.steps.audit.deficits.length === 0,
    },
  )
  .exit('clean', ctx => ctx.steps.audit.deficits.length === 0)
  .exit('exhausted');

const linearKey = H.env('LINEAR_API_KEY');
const trackerStore = linear.store({
  apiKey: linearKey,
  team: 'ENG',
  states: {
    Triage: 'Triage',
    InProgress: 'In Progress',
    InReview: 'In Review',
    Planning: 'Planning',
    AwaitingFeatures: 'In Progress',
    Done: 'Done',
    Unresolved: 'Canceled',
    Cancelled: 'Canceled',
  },
});

function titleOf(file: FolderFile): string {
  const title = file.frontmatter.title;
  return typeof title === 'string' ? title : file.name;
}

const bugLane = H.lane('bugs', Bug)
  .supply(linear.issues({ apiKey: linearKey, team: 'ENG', labels: ['bug'] }), (issue, to) =>
    to.create({ ref: issue.identifier, title: issue.title, description: issue.description }),
  )
  .supply(folder.files({ path: 'bugs', glob: '*.md' }), (file, to) =>
    to.create({ ref: `file:${file.name}`, title: titleOf(file), description: file.body }),
  )
  .supply(H.operator)
  .store(trackerStore)
  .handler(buildAndAudit, {
    exits: { clean: done, exhausted: unresolved },
    during: { build: inProgress, audit: inReview },
    cancelled,
    params: { rounds: 3 },
  });

const featureLane = H.lane('features', Feature)
  .supply(linear.issues({ apiKey: linearKey, team: 'ENG', labels: ['feature'] }), (issue, to) =>
    to.create({ ref: issue.identifier, title: issue.title, description: issue.description }),
  )
  .supply(H.operator)
  .store(trackerStore)
  .handler(buildAndAudit, {
    exits: { clean: done, exhausted: unresolved },
    during: { build: inProgress, audit: inReview },
    cancelled,
    params: { rounds: 5 },
  });

const decomposeEpic = H.flow('decompose-epic')
  .input(ticket)
  .step('plan', planner, ctx => ({
    task: `Decompose epic ${ctx.unit.attributes.ref}: ${ctx.unit.attributes.title}\n\n${ctx.unit.attributes.description}`,
    skills: ['planning'],
  }))
  .spawn('features', featureLane, ctx =>
    ctx.steps.plan.features.map((feature, index) => ({
      ref: `${ctx.unit.attributes.ref}-f${index + 1}`,
      title: feature.title,
      description: feature.description,
    })),

  .on(NegotiationExpired, { enter: Expired });

const negotiationExpiry = H.trigger('negotiation-expiry')
  .on(H.when.timer(negotiations, { at: unit => new Date(unit.attributes.deadline), if: unit => unit.position !== 'terminal' }))
  .signal(negotiations, NegotiationExpired, event => ({ key: event.unit.key, payload: {} }));

export const lifecycles = H.harness('lifecycles')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: 'state/ledger.db' }))
  .pools(H.pool('lifecycle-pool').accounts(apiAccount))
  .lanes(experiments, tenancies, negotiations)
  .triggers(negotiationExpiry)
  .scheduler(
    H.scheduler('lifecycle-scheduler')
      .priority(negotiations, tenancies, experiments)
      .admit(experiments, ctx => {
        const record = ctx.metrics.outcomes({ of: experiments, windowDays: 180 });
        const decided = record.byState['a-wins'] + record.byState['b-wins'] + record.byState.inconclusive;
        const inconclusiveShare = decided === 0 ? 0 : record.byState.inconclusive / decided;
        const concurrentExperiments = decided >= 10 && inconclusiveShare > 0.5 ? 1 : 4;
        return ctx.open(experiments) <= concurrentExperiments;
      }),
  )
  .clients(
    claudeCode.supervisor('lifecycle-supervisor', {
      grants: [H.ops.workRead, H.ops.workCreate, H.ops.workCancel, H.ops.workSignal, H.ops.blockersResolve, H.ops.telemetryRead],
    }),
  )
  .observers(markdown.board({ path: 'board.md' }));

=== END ===
